full_page.content:
1949, March 6
Mrs. Margaret Doyle Page 2.
P. S. Pl. pardon hast. £ I am just starting, for a day or so at Milwaukee, Wis.
Praised be Jesus! Praised Mary our Blessed Mother: Fr. Sol.
July 8th Blessed be God: Dear Mrs. Doyle: God bless you . . I am sending this (above) just as I found it this morning. With several others I got From- ane poison in Milwaukee and had an experience quite worthwhile. Thanks be to God.
Afterwards too, here and in St. Joseph Hospital in Ft. Wayne. Doctor Hoffman there, I hear, feared I would lose my lower legs. I never thought of such a serious thing. Thank God they are again quite OK.
. Fr. Solanus, Ofm. Cap.
Original in possession of: Joseph Doyle 954 Barrington Grosse Pointe, Mi.48230
